Export

The Export function creates a compressed archive of your business data up to a specified date. This feature helps you manage the size of your business file by removing old transactions while maintaining accurate financial records.

How Export Works

When you export your data, the system removes all transactions dated before your specified date. However, it preserves essential information by creating starting balance entries for all accounts with non-zero balances.

The export process automatically retains all unpaid sales invoices and purchase invoices, regardless of their date. This ensures your accounts receivable and accounts payable records remain intact.

What Gets Preserved

The following items are preserved during export:

• Starting balances for all general ledger accounts

• Unpaid sales invoices and purchase invoices

• Customer and supplier balances

• Inventory quantities and values

• All transactions dated on or after the export date

What Gets Removed

The export process removes:

• All fully paid transactions before the export date

• Bank reconciliations before the export date

• Transaction history and audit trail before the export date

• Attachments linked to removed transactions

Important Considerations

After exporting, the system automatically sets a lock date one day before your export date. This prevents accidental modification of the preserved starting balances.

The export creates a new file with the export date included in the filename. Your original business file remains unchanged, allowing you to keep a complete historical record if needed.
